reasoning_content:
Node 20 is installed. Alright, let's start pulling the Docker images in the background while I proceed with the npm install.

Images needed:
- pgvector/pgvector:pg15
- postgres:15.5-bookworm
- keycloak (I'll build a custom startuphafen-keycloak from quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:26.1.2, so I need to pull that base image)
- maildev/maildev
- caddy:2.11-alpine
- dpage/pgadmin4:8.12.0
- mcr.microsoft.com/devcontainers/typescript-node:20-bookworm (devcontainer base)

Let me kick off npm install in the background, and simultaneously start the Docker pulls in the background too.

action.command:
cd /workspace && nohup npm install --no-audit --no-fund > /tmp/npm_install.log 2>&1 &
echo "npm install started: $!"

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace && nohup npm install --no-audit --no-fund > /tmp/npm_install.log 2>&1 &\necho \"npm install started: $!\"", "summary": "Start npm install in background", "security_risk": "MEDIUM"}
